# Bazozo

> Bazozo Studio is a Product & Engineering Studio based in India, serving clients worldwide (remote). Four core pillars: Web & E-Commerce (custom web, WordPress, Shopify/headless, speed & SEO); Browser Extensions & Plugins (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, WordPress plugins); Cross-Platform Apps (iOS, Android, macOS & Windows utilities, mobile games); Brand Film & Motion (video editing, interactive scroll & WebGL).

## Services
SEO & technical SEO, website migration, website redesign, performance optimization, e-commerce development, CMS development, landing page design, UI/UX design, web app development, API integration, progressive web apps, accessibility audits, security hardening, analytics & tracking, conversion rate optimization, hosting & domain setup, website maintenance, multilingual localization, legacy system modernization.

## Disciplines
Websites, video editing, Chrome extensions, Firefox Add-ons, Safari App Extensions, WordPress Plugins, Android apps, iOS apps, Windows Applications, macOS Applications, Android games, iOS games.
